_about: Batch B1 terms (learn/what-is-afd, learn/vllm-v1-map, concepts/plugin-entry-point, afd-config, worker-selection, model-registration, code/config-py, code/validation-py). Owner: writer B1. Reuse ids from core.json, s1.json and s2.json; do not redefine them.

pd-disaggregation.short: A serving layout that runs prefill and decode in separate processes. Each process still runs the whole model. It splits by phase, not by model part.

async-dp.short: An AFD config flag. It is NPU-only: it turns on the async data-parallel patches, is gated at run time, and must be false on GPU.
async-dp.long: Read by is_afd_async_dp ({{cite afd_plugin/config.py:295-308}}); it needs the async CAM connector.
